recordistRights.publisherScope: Valve permits use of Valve game material in qualifying videos under its own policy. Treat audio, non-Valve material and platform actions separately.
recordistRights.plannedCredit: Portal 2 © Valve. Gameplay recorded by Royalty Free Game Clips. Source 5V7N_pKLVUw. Selected and annotated excerpts.

video.recordingEvidence: Original uploader describes a PC capture. The archived MP4's first 4800 compressed video packets are byte-exact to the live original 1080p format 299, covering every proposed source cue. Keep the source speed, ratio and frame ordering.

observedCandidateCues.before: At corridor height a green door pictogram anchors the far end.
observedCandidateCues.action: The view advances and the articulated panel rig beside the corridor changes position.
observedCandidateCues.result: The door sign and side lights remain visible at different sampled frames. Use the sequence to introduce route information before looking for overhead structure.

observedCandidateCues.before: At the floor the chamber reads as a walking space with a panel ahead.
observedCandidateCues.action: As the view points higher, the raised structure and deeper volume enter the picture.
observedCandidateCues.result: The upper route and large vertical difference become inspectable. Describe the visible geometry without inferring a fall penalty.

observedCandidateCues.before: A marked floor mechanism and directional icon are visible.
observedCandidateCues.action: The view moves from the floor to above, revealing lit panels, beams and broken upper structure, then returns toward the floor.
observedCandidateCues.result: Compare visual cues and relative height. The recording can contain both movement and a gaze change. Keep the pitch-only comparison in the authored room.

observedCandidateCues.before: A ledge, arrow sign and floor fixture are visible at different points before the upward view.
observedCandidateCues.action: The recorder looks toward the overhead panel and an orange portal appears in the sampled view.
observedCandidateCues.result: The recording shows a usable surface at height. Do not generalize every bright square into a portal surface or claim unseen input details.

gameplaySource.limits: Decoded frame samples establish observed before/action/result candidates. Verify continuous natural-speed motion, captions, target masks and complete audio-independent timing before final edit. The first 4800 original packets are verified. Extend the direct comparison before selecting later material.

authoredComparison.renderer: Unity with two synchronized cameras on the same position path
authoredComparison.finding: At 121 matched positions the door-header point stays in both views. The exit view misses all four ceiling-strip corners. The look-up view includes all four corners. The test changes only pitch.
authoredComparison.visualDirection: Bind the same strip and door header to one route in a plan view. Show the change in frame coverage at the moment of looking up. Test the end of the strip near the upper frame against the headline and caption space at 1080 and 375 widths.

sourceAlignment.scope: Preproduction P01–P09 order and preserved bilingual narration
decisions: Use the actual test chamber to show the question, then isolate pitch in the authored room.
Keep observation, hypothesis and later comparison separate. Gun placement, dark areas, lighting and level intent are separate claims.
Preserve rules, movement choices, narrative evidence and repeated art as separate observation categories. Use authored diagrams when the acquired game scene does not show a category.

next: Confirm continuous candidate spans and scope of the footage mix, prepare the editable Unity room, and finalize exact speech cues after actual approved narration and capture.
